name: Is cracked window glass replacement covered by homeowner's insurance?

mainEntity.name: Is cracked window glass replacement covered by homeowner's insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coverage for cracked window glass replacement depends on the cause of the damage and your specific homeowner's insurance policy. Damage caused by perils such as vandalism, hail, or falling objects is often covered. However, damage due to normal wear and tear or neglect is typically not. It's advisable to review your policy details or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage limitations and deductible before scheduling replacement services.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coverage depends on the cause of damage and your policy. Perils like vandalism or storms may be covered, but wear and tear is usually not. Check with your insurance provider.
